title: 迪士尼推进重组 削减成本目标两成
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Another story of more restructuring at Disney Geeta, what difference do we expect this round to make?
segments.zh: 迪士尼又有重组消息，吉塔，我们预计这轮会带来什么不同？

segments.en: Yeah, thanks so much, Danny. So I think, you know, we've seen all these small targeted cuts coming from Disney ever since Josh Demaro took over a CEO and March of 2026.
segments.zh: 谢谢丹尼。自2026年3月乔什·达马罗接任CEO以来，迪士尼一直在进行小规模定向裁员。

segments.en: I think this one will be the broadest and the most sweeping. And really there are two things that I think he's trying to do here.
segments.zh: 我认为这次将是最广泛、最彻底的一次。他主要想实现两件事。

segments.en: So one is preserve this whole earning story. So remember, Disney will post about 16% growth in EPS this year.
segments.zh: 一是维持盈利叙事。记住，迪士尼今年每股收益将增长约16%。

segments.en: They've guided to double digit EPS growth next year.
segments.zh: 他们指引明年每股收益将实现两位数增长。

segments.en: So this, you know, all of these savings are obviously going to feed into that.
segments.zh: 这些节省显然都会对此有所贡献。

segments.en: I think investors are obviously looking for that double digit EPS story to keep continuing into the future.
segments.zh: 市场参与者显然希望两位数每股收益的故事能持续下去。

segments.en: And then more importantly, as you just pointed out, Danny, is to take some of those savings from these job cuts and basically reinvest them in the growth parts of
segments.zh: 更重要的是，正如你指出的，丹尼，将部分裁员节省重新配置到增长业务中。

segments.en: and by growth part of the business, I mean really the streaming business.
segments.zh: 增长业务主要指流媒体业务。

segments.en: This is an area where they need to invest heavily in order to grow margins as well as revenues sustainably.
segments.zh: 这个领域需要大力投入，才能持续提升利润率和收入。

segments.en: But Geesa, can Disney cut this deeply without hurting the company's growth prospects?
segments.zh: 但吉萨，迪士尼能否在不损害公司增长前景的情况下进行如此大幅度的削减？

segments.en: Because they wanted to move some of those money into TV and to your point also streaming and other technologies?
segments.zh: 因为他们想将部分资金投入电视业务，并且如你所说，也投入流媒体和其他技术？

segments.en: I think they are. I think, you know, Josh Demaro here is taking really a very long term view of the company.
segments.zh: 我认为他们正在这样做。我认为，你知道，这里的乔什·德马罗正在对公司采取非常长期的视角。

segments.en: And if you really look at the look at, you know, the stock price is a bell over the past year or so it's been flatish.
segments.zh: 如果你真的看看，你知道，过去一年左右的股价，它一直持平。
